upstream.modification: The vendored source is modified in two documented, mechanical ways, both applied by scripts/sync-vendor.mjs and both re-verified by `npm run vendor:check` against the published tarball: a token rename that moves the upstream product name out of CSS class names and font stacks, and a strip of the inlined @font-face rule. The MIT notice obligation is unaffected. See vendor/threeui/README.md.

thirdParty.name: Three.js
thirdParty.notice: Three.js is redistributed unmodified under the MIT License. Upstream copyright headers are retained in the bundled runtime.

thirdParty.name: React and React DOM
thirdParty.notice: React and React DOM are redistributed unmodified under the MIT License.

thirdParty.name: NASA Blue Marble land mask
thirdParty.notice: The upstream source tree carries a NASA Blue Marble land-mask attribution inside its globe items. No card in this gallery derives from those items, so no NASA notice is required for anything that ships here. The notice is recorded so that the next person who adds a globe item knows it is owed.

thirdParty.name: Bundled OFL fonts (Fragment Mono, Instrument Serif, Newsreader, Onest)

reservedFontNames.note: The upstream package bundles one OFL 1.1 font whose licence carries a Reserved Font Name. The name is recorded, not printed: an OFL Reserved Font Name may not be used by a derivative work, so this file, the built page and every shipped chunk omit it. It is not used by any card. `vendor/threeui/FONT-LICENSES.md` holds the upstream text.

thirdParty.notice: The upstream stylesheet inlines a base64 WOFF2 under the family name "ThreeUI Fragment Mono" (SIL Open Font License 1.1, The Fragment-Mono Project Authors, no Reserved Font Name). This gallery strips the @font-face rule at vendor time, recorded in vendor/threeui.manifest.json and re-checked by `npm run vendor:check`, so no font file, no base64 font payload and no font licence obligation ships here. Every typography-driven card uses the system UI and monospace stacks. The upstream package also bundles a second OFL 1.1 font whose licence reserves its family name; that name is deliberately not reproduced anywhere in this repository or on the built page, and no card uses it. See `reservedFontNames` above.

additionalNotices: Authored against an older Three.js release. It assigns renderer.outputEncoding = LinearEncoding | sRGBEncoding, an API removed in Three r152. On the pinned r186 runtime the assignment is a no-op and the renderer keeps its default sRGB output, which is what the sRGB branch intended. The LinearEncoding branch renders brighter than the author intended.

Authored against an older Three.js release. Its scene assigns renderer.outputEncoding = sRGBEncoding, an API removed in Three r152. On the pinned r186 runtime the assignment is a no-op and the renderer keeps its default sRGB output, so the rendered result matches the author's intent.
